rule: Reuse the existing three 4-layer circular baseline runs (100 tokens). Train uniform_extra and resonance (132 tokens each) with identical 320938 parameter backbone, same shared Conv10, absolute center/span encoding and extra-token indicator. Fixed input-only SG11/poly3, prominence 0.01, distance20; at most two valleys, 16 tokens/window, total window span four half-prominence widths clipped to 16..240 original grid intervals; no-valley fallback is uniform32; single-valley second window is uniform16. Original R is never smoothed or locally depth-normalized. These rules are frozen before validation. All three seeds use identical initialization and training recipe. Replacement requires >=1% lower mean joint-mirror validation MSE than the current baseline, length MSE at most +2%, dX MAE +5%, dY MAE +2%. Attribute benefit to valley selection only if resonance also beats matched uniform_extra mean validation MSE by >=1% with the same dimension safeguards. Otherwise report that mechanism unestablished. Minimum eligible validation MSE wins, median-validation seed retained; freeze before test.
